overview.description: The Roundhill UNH WeeklyPay ETF (UNHW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of UnitedHealth Group Incorporated stock (UNH). UNHW was launched on Dec 3, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
